headline: Lenovo Q2 Revenue Jumps 48% to $30.2 Billion Driven by AI Hardware Demand
summary: Lenovo reported a 48% surge in second-quarter revenue to $30.2 billion, topping consensus estimates due to high demand for AI servers and hardware, though it posted a HKFRS net loss of $640 million.
why: Lenovo is the world's largest personal computer vendor and a key supplier of enterprise infrastructure and AI servers globally.

impacts.name: Lenovo Group
impacts.why: Strong top-line revenue growth in AI servers was offset by net losses under accounting standards.
